description: Report a mistake or missing item in the catalog (reviewed by hand before anything changes). Example: {sku_id: "ichiban-kuji-kh-2018-a", field: "msrp_jpy", proposed_value: "750", source_url: "https://…"}. Please include a primary source (maker, official shop or reliable press) when you can. Returns {accepted, correction_id}.

field.description: What is wrong, as a catalog field name, e.g. "name_en", "msrp_jpy", "availability_hint", "official", or "new_item".

proposed_value.description: The correct value (or, for a new item, its name and details).

sku_id.description: The item's sku_id. Leave empty to suggest a new item.

source_url.description: URL of a primary source that confirms it. Optional but strongly preferred.

name: report_correction
title: Report correction
